description: Invoice Matching exercise: approved invoices waiting for payment. A participant's process writes one row per approved invoice: automatically on green, after the reviewer's Approve otherwise. CreatedBy is the user whose process wrote the row; the course tracks progress by it.

fields.Name: InvoiceNumber
fields.Description: The invoice number, INV-<8 digits>, from the extracted invoice.

fields.Name: PONumber
fields.Description: The purchase order number the invoice was matched against, PO-<8 digits>.

fields.Name: Vendor
fields.Description: The vendor name as it appears on the invoice.

fields.Name: Currency
fields.Description: The invoice currency, ISO code (EUR, USD, RON, ...).

fields.Name: Total
fields.Description: The invoice total including tax, as invoiced.

fields.Name: MatchStatus
fields.Description: green, yellow or red: the match rating the invoice was approved with. green from the deterministic compare or the agent; yellow or red when a reviewer approved it anyway.

fields.Name: ApprovedBy
fields.Description: automatic when the process approved the invoice without a reviewer (green); otherwise the reviewer's e-mail, from the Invoice Validation app's ReviewerEmail output.

fields.Name: InvoiceData
fields.Description: The extracted invoice as JSON text: out_InvoiceJSON of Extract Invoice Data (IXP), unchanged.
